caption: The drawing depicts a stylized rooster-shaped object, likely a weather vane, with a distinct, elongated neck and a large, fan-like tail. The rooster's body is composed of soft beige, light brown, and muted purple-gray tones, giving it a multi-tonal, patchwork appearance. The tail features alternating stripes of yellowish-beige and a dull blue-gray color. The rooster stands on one leg, which is mounted on a round, brownish sphere. There is a vertical rod extending downward from the sphere, and the background is a solid light beige with no other objects present. The rooster has a small comb on its head and a carved or segmented appearance in its body and tail, suggesting it is made of assembled parts or panels.
title: Rooster Weather Vane
